SQL_STMT_U.val: SELECT PKD_FMDC, COUNT(PCS_CSNO) FROM PCS_DATA, PKD_LTID WHERE PCS_CSDT = ':1' AND (PCS_PCNO = PKD_PCNO) GROUP BY PKD_FMDC ORDER BY PKD_FMDC

SELECT PKD_FMDC, SUM(CNT) FROM ((SELECT PKD_FMDC, COUNT(A.PCS_PCNO) CNT FROM ((SELECT PCS_PCNO, PCS_LTNO, PCS_CNNO, PCS_CSNO FROM PCS_DATA, PCR_DATA WHERE PCS_CSDT = ':1' AND (PCS_PCNO = PCR_PCNO AND PCS_LTNO = PCR_LTNO AND PCS_CNNO = PCR_CNNO AND PCS_CSNO = PCR_CSNO) AND PCR_CROF = 1 AND PCR_APKD = ':1' GROUP BY PCS_PCNO, PCS_LTNO, PCS_CNNO, PCS_CSNO) MINUS ( SELECT PCS_PCNO, PCS_LTNO, PCS_CNNO, PCS_CSNO FROM PCS_DATA, PCR_DATA WHERE PCS_CSDT = ':1' AND (PCS_PCNO = PCR_PCNO AND PCS_LTNO = PCR_LTNO AND PCS_CNNO = PCR_CNNO AND PCS_CSNO = PCR_CSNO) AND ((PCR_CROF = 1 AND PCR_APKD > ':1' AND PCR_APKD > PCS_CSDT) OR (PCR_CROF = 0)) GROUP BY PCS_PCNO, PCS_LTNO, PCS_CNNO, PCS_CSNO)) A, PKD_LTID WHERE A.PCS_PCNO = PKD_PCNO GROUP BY PKD_FMDC) UNION ALL (SELECT PKD_FMDC, COUNT(A.PCR_PCNO) CNT FROM ((SELECT PCR_PCNO, PCR_LTNO, PCR_CNNO, PCR_CSNO FROM PCR_DATA, PCS_DATA, PKD_LTID WHERE (PCR_CROF =1 AND PCR_APKD = ':1') AND (PCR_PCNO = PCS_PCNO AND PCR_LTNO = PCS_LTNO AND PCR_CNNO = PCS_CNNO AND PCR_CSNO = PCS_CSNO) AND PCS_CSDT <> ':1' GROUP BY PCR_PCNO, PCR_LTNO, PCR_CNNO, PCR_CSNO) MINUS (SELECT B.BPC, B.BLT, B.BCN, B.BCS FROM (SELECT D.PCR_PCNO BPC, D.PCR_LTNO BLT, D.PCR_CNNO BCN, D.PCR_CSNO BCS, E.PCR_APKD BPD FROM (SELECT PCR_PCNO, PCR_LTNO, PCR_CNNO, PCR_CSNO FROM PCR_DATA, PCS_DATA, PKD_LTID WHERE (PCR_CROF =1 AND PCR_APKD = ':1') AND (PCR_PCNO = PCS_PCNO AND PCR_LTNO = PCS_LTNO AND PCR_CNNO = PCS_CNNO AND PCR_CSNO = PCS_CSNO) AND PCS_CSDT <> ':1' GROUP BY PCR_PCNO, PCR_LTNO, PCR_CNNO, PCR_CSNO) D, PCR_DATA E WHERE (D.PCR_PCNO = E.PCR_PCNO AND D.PCR_LTNO = E.PCR_LTNO AND D.PCR_CNNO = E.PCR_CNNO AND D.PCR_CSNO = E.PCR_CSNO) GROUP BY D.PCR_PCNO, D.PCR_LTNO, D.PCR_CNNO, D.PCR_CSNO, E.PCR_APKD) B, PCR_DATA C WHERE (B.BPC = C.PCR_PCNO AND B.BLT = C.PCR_LTNO AND B.BCN = C.PCR_CNNO AND B.BCS = C.PCR_CSNO) AND C.PCR_CROF = 0 OR (C.PCR_CROF = 1 AND B.BPD > ':1') GROUP BY B.BPC, B.BLT, B.BCN, B.BCS) ) A, PKD_LTID WHERE (A.PCR_PCNO = PKD_PCNO) GROUP BY PKD_FMDC)) GROUP BY PKD_FMDC

SELECT PKD_FMDC, COUNT(PCR_CRNO) FROM PCS_DATA, PCR_DATA, PKD_LTID WHERE PCS_CSDT = ':1' AND (PCS_PCNO = PCR_PCNO AND PCS_LTNO = PCR_LTNO AND PCS_CNNO = PCR_CNNO AND PCS_CSNO = PCR_CSNO) AND (PCS_PCNO = PKD_PCNO) GROUP BY PKD_FMDC ORDER BY PKD_FMDC
SELECT PKD_FMDC, COUNT(PCR_CRNO) FROM PCR_DATA, PKD_LTID WHERE PCR_APKD = ':1' AND PCR_CROF = 1 AND PCR_PCNO = PKD_PCNO GROUP BY PKD_FMDC
